nodes.label: PR Template API Contract Checklist
nodes.rationale: Enforces the protocol-first contract rule at PR time: any change to @logact-pub/opc-protocol requires full typecheck/test/e2e, breaking changes require a major changeset plus synced updates to apps/mobile and api-client/mqtt-client, and breaking-change PRs must document the break, migration path, and compat-layer retention plan.
